title: CKD Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS)
summary: A clinical decision support system for early detection and management of Chronic Kidney Disease, combining a Bayesian Neural Network diagnostic engine with computer vision-based dipstick analysis and a RAG clinical guideline chat. Its preprocessing pipeline uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer to generate synthetic patient records for data augmentation ahead of model training.
evidence: src/tabular/preprocess_uci2.py:70-78: TVAESynthesizer(metadata, epochs=300, batch_size=64); synthesizer.fit/sample used to augment training data
